annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the President of the Russian Federation (translated by CSET)
key_provisions_or_claims: Approves National AI Development Strategy to 2030 with targets for 2024 and 2030
Sets principles: human rights, security, transparency, technological sovereignty, innovation cycle integrity, competition
Calls for experimental legal regimes and simplified testing of AI, warning against excessive regulation
Calls for standardization, conformity assessment and certification systems for AI products
Mandates federal project 'Artificial Intelligence', annual reporting and a coordinating commission and business-science association
annotation.summary_en: Presidential Decree No. 490 approving Russia's National Strategy for AI Development to 2030 (CSET translation). It sets principles, priorities, goals and 2024/2030 targets for research, software, data, hardware, talent and regulation, favoring light-touch rules, experimental legal regimes, standardization and certification, with only passing mention of robotics.
